verdict.rationale: Batch-mode docs describe a registrable notifications.webhook_url plus secret. Scribe sends an outbound POST to that URL when a job finishes, signed with an x-zm-signature HMAC-SHA256 header and timestamp, and the docs give explicit verification and replay-rejection guidance. This is a genuine programmatic webhook, but it covers only the batch job-completion event and is registered per job rather than as a general event subscription. Missing for 10: webhooks for other event types (e.g., per-file or live-session events), account-level subscription management, a documented payload schema or retry policy, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
